tools.name: verify_listing_registration
tools.description: Check whether a short-term rental listing (Airbnb, guesthouse, hanok stay, minpaku, homestay, pension) is licensed and registered with the government, using official government records (registries and published permit lists) that are hard to access directly. SelectBNBs Verify covers South Korea and parts of Japan today; more countries are coming. Use it when someone asks whether a Korean or Japanese Airbnb or guesthouse is legal, licensed, registered or real. Pass the listing's 'Registration details' box exactly as shown (Region of issuance, Licence type, Licence number). If the traveler has not copied it yet, ask them to; for Korea, a registered name or Korean road address is a weaker fallback. For Japan, also send name and address as shown on the listing: hotel and inn (旅館業) and special-zone minpaku (特区民泊) lists often publish no permit numbers. Returns the official permit status and its as-of date, the registered business name, permit category and address, a link to the public record page (for Japan: the issuer's list, its date and the source credit, with its licence or terms link, to show with it), and what the traveler should compare with their listing. One listing per call; no bulk search.

listing_details.description: Text copied from ONE listing, as shown: ideally the whole Registration details box (e.g. 'Region of issuance: 서울특별시 종로구 / Licence type: 외국인관광도시민박업 / Licence number: 2025-000006', or for Japan 'Hotels and Inns Business Act | 東京都台東区台東保健所 | 7台台健生環き第10158号' or 'M130012345'). For Korea, a registered name, Korean road address or government management number also works, less reliably.
listing_details.title: Listing Details

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country where the stay is, e.g. KR. Only KR (South Korea) and JP (parts of Japan) are covered today; other countries return 'not covered yet'.
country.title: Country

language.description: Language for explanations and next steps: en (default), ja or zh-Hant.
language.title: Language

name.description: The stay's name as shown on the listing. Needed for Japanese hotel and inn and special-zone minpaku lists, which often publish no permit numbers; otherwise optional.
name.title: Name

address.description: The stay's address as shown on the listing, in Japanese if available. Needed for Japanese hotel and inn and special-zone minpaku lists, which often publish no permit numbers; otherwise optional.
address.title: Address

tools.name: get_permit_record
tools.description: Fetch one accommodation permit record from official government data. For Korea: by its government management number (e.g. AGCV065100002024000451), optionally with its Korean issuing region, or by registered business name together with the Korean issuing region (e.g. name 'Jobs', region '서울특별시 종로구'). For Japan: by a minpaku (住宅宿泊事業) notification number only (e.g. M130012345); hotel and inn and special-zone licences have no lookup number, so check those with verify_listing_registration. SelectBNBs Verify covers South Korea and parts of Japan today; more countries are coming. It takes one of these identifiers and does not read text copied from a listing. Returns one record (status, category, permit date, record page link, citation, and for Japan the list's source credit) or says why no single record could be chosen. Never lists or browses records.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country where the stay is, e.g. KR. Only KR (South Korea) and JP (parts of Japan) are covered today; other countries return 'not covered yet'.
country.title: Country

management_number.description: For Korea: full government management number, e.g. AGCV065100002024000451. Urban-homestay and hanok numbers (CDFI...) repeat across local governments; send those with region. For Japan: a minpaku notification number, e.g. M130012345.
management_number.title: Management Number

name.description: For Korea: registered business name (사업장명). Send together with region. Not used for Japan.
name.title: Name

region.description: For Korea: the issuing region in Korean, e.g. 서울특별시 종로구. Required with name; optional with management_number, where it picks the local government that issued a shared number. Not used for Japan.
region.title: Region
